notes: Modified Terminal-Bench 2.1 fixed-QEMU snapshot (bench-run revision qemu-fixed-6h-v1), 89 tasks × 5 attempts and a six-hour agent deadline. Not an unmodified leaderboard evaluation.

HF Jobs (cpu-basic/upgrade; total concurrency 20), Harbor 69105fe5, and the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.68 wheel (ptc extra). GPT-6 Luna (high reasoning) through the OpenAI Responses API with an API key (standard service tier) and Programmatic Tool Calling (ptc=on).

Ten designated full-trial infrastructure replacements (nine standing; one superseded): three connection errors, six nonzero agent exits during verification, and one remote protocol error. One bio_policy refusal and one mcmc-sampling-stan VerifierTimeoutError remain in the scored set. Score was 335/445 as run and 340/445 after replacements, before integrity review.

Harbor recorded cost at the configured OpenAI standard rates (card-packs pricing catalog 2026-11-18.1-bench-hftencent-20261120, rules gpt-6-luna-standard-short / -long: $0.10 / $0.01 / $0.125 / $0.50 per million input / cached / cache-write / output tokens; $0.20 / $0.02 / $0.25 / $0.75 above 272k context). Some trials had incomplete usage accounting, so the recorded cost is a lower bound.
